meta.title: Trisle — The Dynamic Island. For Android.
meta.description: Trisle floats above everything on your phone — music, timers, calls, turn-by-turn directions and every notification, rendered in fluid spring physics. One purchase. Yours forever.
hero.desc: Trisle floats above everything on your phone — music, timers, calls, turn-by-turn directions and every notification, rendered in fluid spring physics. One purchase. Yours forever.
features.label: Features
features.title1: Everything at the top of your screen.
features.desc: Trisle lives in a whisper-thin overlay above every app — showing exactly what matters, for exactly as long as it matters.
features.live.title: Real Live Activities
features.live.desc: Music, timers, calls and Google Maps navigation become living capsules that update in real time — no unlock, no app switch.
features.alerts.title: Smart system alerts
features.alerts.desc: Charging, low battery, ringer changes and Bluetooth pairing appear instantly — each with its own duration.
features.triple.title: Triple Island, iOS 27 style
features.triple.desc: Run up to three activities at once. A main capsule flanked by detached bubbles — tap to swap in a heartbeat.
features.tuned.title: Tuned to your taste
features.tuned.desc: Five morph animations, three spring presets, adjustable size, glow and per-alert durations.
features.quiet.title: True black. True quiet.
features.quiet.desc: Pitch-black pixels rest your OLED display, while a low-priority foreground service sips battery. Zero analytics, zero tracking.
activities.label: Live Activities
activities.music.headline: Your soundtrack, always in reach
activities.music.desc: The moment a track starts playing, the island wakes up. Scrub the timeline, skip, pause — without leaving whatever you were doing.
activities.music.p1: Works with Spotify, YouTube Music, Apple Music & more
activities.music.p2: Full transport controls and live seekbar
activities.nav.headline: Turn-by-turn, at a glance
activities.nav.desc: Start navigation in Google Maps and the island becomes a co-pilot — the next maneuver, distance, road and ETA floating above everything.
activities.nav.p1: Parses maneuver, distance and road in real time
activities.nav.p2: One tap opens Maps for full guidance
activities.nav.p3: Compact pill shows countdown distance while collapsed
activities.timer.headline: Every second, visible
activities.timer.desc: Timers and stopwatches from your clock app live in the island — counting down right at the top of the screen, even in fullscreen apps.
activities.call.headline: Calls that stay out of the way
activities.call.desc: Ongoing calls become a slim capsule with live duration. Glance, talk, hang up. Your conversation — not a full-screen takeover.
activities.call.p3: Disappears the moment the call ends
customize.label: Customize
customize.desc: Pick one of five physics-based morph styles — each re-tuned spring constants, so the island moves exactly how you imagine it. Tap a style and watch the demo replay.
pers.size.title: Size & position
pers.size.desc: Width, height, corner radius, top margin and horizontal offset — pixel-perfect alignment with any cutout.
pers.glow.title: Glow & finish
pers.glow.desc: Six rim colors from Specular White to Rainbow Aura, three background finishes, three text scales.
pers.gestures.title: Gestures
pers.gestures.desc: Assign tap and long-press to expand, dismiss or jump straight into the source app. Swipe to cycle activities.
pers.timing.title: Per-alert timing
pers.timing.desc: Charging 3s, ringer 2.5s, notifications 4.5s — every alert duration is independently tunable.
pers.privacy.title: Privacy behaviour
pers.privacy.desc: Auto-hide when idle and redact notification content while the lock screen is on.
pers.filter.title: App filter
pers.filter.desc: Whitelist or blacklist apps. Trisle stays quiet from the ones you don't want to hear from.
how.label: Setup
how.s1.title: Install Trisle
how.s1.desc: Buy once, download the APK, install. No account, no sign-up, no tracking SDKs bundled inside.
how.s2.title: Grant two permissions
how.s2.desc: Display-over-other-apps and notification access — both handled by Android's own system dialogs, one tap each.
how.s3.title: Flip the switch
how.s3.desc: The island wakes up, aligned to your cutout. Play some music or plug in your charger and watch it morph.
how.requirements: Requires Android 7.0+ · Optimized for Android 12–16 · Works with any cutout position — center, left or right
screenshots.label: Inside the app
screenshots.sub: No staged mockups — this is the actual Trisle setup on Android. Step through its four tabs to see exactly what you get.
screenshots.s1.title: Dial in the fit
screenshots.s1.desc: Line the island up with your camera cutout — center, left or right — then fine-tune resting width and height with dp-level sliders and a live preview on top.
screenshots.s2.title: Every app, your call
screenshots.s2.desc: Search what's installed and mute any app from the island with one toggle. Filtering runs 100% on-device — nothing ever leaves your phone.
screenshots.s3.title: Pick your morph
screenshots.s3.desc: Five animation styles, from iOS Classic Morph to Bubble Pop, each tunable with bouncy, smooth or snappy spring physics.
screenshots.s4.title: Triggers & privacy
screenshots.s4.desc: Charging, ringer, music, Bluetooth and low-battery triggers — plus lock-screen redaction and haptic feedback, all under your control.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.a1: Trisle is a small overlay app that recreates the iPhone's Dynamic Island on Android. It floats a pill-shaped capsule at the top of your screen — above every app — and morphs it to show live alerts, notifications and ongoing activities like music playback, timers, calls and Google Maps navigation.
faq.q2: Which Android versions does it support?
faq.a2: Trisle runs on Android 7.0 and above, and is fully optimized for Android 12 through 16. It adapts to any camera cutout — centered, left or right — so it looks native on virtually any device.
faq.a3: No. The island renders in true black, which modern OLED panels effectively switch off, and it runs as a low-priority foreground service that only wakes on real system events. When idle, it can hide itself completely to free the GPU and compositor.
faq.a4: Completely. Everything — notification parsing, media session sync, navigation text extraction — happens strictly on your device. Trisle collects nothing, transmits nothing and contains no analytics or tracking SDKs. On the lock screen, notification content can be redacted automatically.
faq.q5: Why does it need notification access?
faq.a5: Android only allows apps to read notification content through the Notification Listener API, which powers the music island, navigation capsule, timers and smart alert banners. The permission is granted through a system settings screen you can revoke at any time.
faq.a6: Trisle is a one-time purchase — €5.99, once, including VAT. Checkout is handled by Polar.sh, which acts as the merchant of record and processes payments, taxes and invoices securely. You receive an instant download and lifetime updates. No subscription, no recurring charges.
faq.a7: No. Trisle is an independent product built for Android. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or connected to Apple Inc. 'Dynamic Island' is a trademark of Apple Inc., referenced here only to describe the interaction style Trisle recreates.
faq.a8: Easy — if Trisle isn't for you, you get a full refund anytime within 7 days of your purchase. No questions asked. Just contact support with your order details and Polar.sh processes it back to your original payment method.
